Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the attachments. Short answer: we prefer portal-first for reliability and automated ACKs, but we accept email fallback for smaller/more urgent invoices. Below is the recommended guidance so your billing team can map fields quickly.

Preferred path: Redwood Vendor Portal
- Upload: single PDF per invoice or a CSV for batched lines (we consume both).
- Acknowledgement: Portal gives immediate ACK and an internal reference ID.
- Filename convention (portal or email upload): RW-<PO#>-<VendorShort>-YYYYMMDD.ext (e.g., RW-4567-LEAFLN-20280318.pdf)

Email fallback (only if portal not feasible):
- Send to invoices@redwood.com, subject: Invoice RW-<PO#> <VendorShort>
- Embed the PO number on the invoice (visible text) and include a machine-readable PO column in CSVs.

Minimal required fields for automated PO match:
- Redwood PO number (exact match)
- Invoice number
- Invoice date (ISO)
- Line items: description, quantity, unit price, line total, tax
- Vendor tax id (if applicable)

For multi-PO invoices: include a PO column per line in CSVs; PDFs need a clear breakdown per PO (we can manually route but it slows processing).

I’ve copied finance (Markus) and vendor onboarding (Kim) to confirm a couple of constraints: Markus, are we ok with accepting CSV-batched invoices for freight vendors? Kim, can you confirm the onboarding form fields we need and whether we require PO stamping on PDFs?

Next step: if you can update the sample CSV with the PO column and re-send, we’ll validate it in a quick test ingest and confirm go-live timing.

Best,

Jordan / Markus — quick finance notes to confirm acceptance rules:

- CSV with PO column: acceptable and preferred for batched freight lines. Our matching job looks for exact PO string; no leading zeros differences.
- Single daily CSV: fine — we ask vendors to include invoice-level invoice_number and invoice_date columns for each row.
- PDF-only invoices without a PO: we will accept but they require manual intervention. If your system cannot stamp PO into the PDF, the CSV PO column is sufficient.
- SFTP: we can support an SFTP drop for high volume uploads. We will provision a vendor-specific folder and provide creds once the onboarding form is complete.

Sam — please confirm you want SFTP creds and whether you’ll continue daily CSV batches or switch to per-PO files. Once you confirm, we’ll schedule the test ingest (we usually run a sandbox ingest 24–48 hours after credentials are set).

Kimberly Park
